signal: PandaDoc named Keith Rabkin CEO with founder Mikita Mikado moving to CPO, and is rolling out a 2026 AI and CPQ product roadmap.

email.body1:
Fernando, saw PandaDoc named Keith Rabkin CEO and lined up a big 2026 AI and CPQ roadmap.

A leadership change plus an expanded roadmap usually raises the pipeline bar faster than headcount can follow, and that is where coverage gaps show up. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so reps stop doing research and CRM work and spend time in meetings: 3-5x more meetings per rep, no new hires.

I built a signal play for PandaDoc off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.subject2: meetings to hit the new number
email.body2:
Fernando, quick follow-up for PandaDoc.

With a new CEO and roadmap, board expectations on pipeline tend to jump before the team grows. Most orgs don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings PandaDoc needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Fernando, last bit of proof for PandaDoc.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how PandaDoc's reply rate likely compares to peer growth-stage SaaS. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Fernando, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority during the transition, no problem at all. A new CEO and roadmap make for a full quarter, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I will tailor it to PandaDoc either way.
